sources.title: A Very Big Video Reasoning Suite
sources.snippet: An unprecedentedly large-scale suite for video reasoning, comprising VBVR-Dataset, VBVR-Bench, and VBVR-DataFactory, enabling systematic scaling studies and emergent generalization in video reasoning models.

sources.snippet: Release Information VBVR-LTX2.3 is trained from LTX-2.3 without architectural modifications, as the goal of VBVR is to investigate data scaling behavior and provide strong baseline models for the video reasoning research community.
